title: Affine perfect-complex cut after a surjective fibre map
statement: Let R be a ring, let p be a prime ideal of R, and let K be a bounded-above complex [def-pc-derived-category] of finite free R-modules. Assume that the canonical map H^0(K) tensor_R kappa(p) to H^0(K tensor_R^L kappa(p)) is surjective. Then there is f not in p such that, in D(R_f), K tensor_R R_f is isomorphic to tau_{<=0}(K tensor_R R_f) direct-sum tau_{>=1}(K tensor_R R_f), and tau_{>=1}(K tensor_R R_f) is perfect of Tor-amplitude in [1,infinity).
